sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK ("key" IN ('theme')), "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value_json) AND json_type(value_json) = 'text' AND json_extract(value_json, '$') IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), "value_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(value_version) = 'integer' AND value_version = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_migrations" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (version > 0), "schema_checksum" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(schema_checksum) = 64), "applied_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(applied_at_utc) = 'integer'), "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(code) = 3 AND code = upper(code)), "fraction_digits" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(fraction_digits) = 'integer' AND fraction_digits BETWEEN 0 AND 4));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_kinds" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "nature" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (nature IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'system')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry_kinds" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "data_sources" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "households" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code), "reserve_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(reserve_minor) = 'integer' AND reserve_minor >= 0), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES account_kinds(kind), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code), "owner_member_id" TEXT REFERENCES members(id), "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('shared', 'private')), "is_protected" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_protected IN (0, 1)), "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER CHECK (credit_limit_minor IS NULL OR(typeof(credit_limit_minor) = 'integer' AND credit_limit_minor >= 0)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(sort_order) = 'integer'), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer'), "archived_at_utc" INTEGER CHECK (archived_at_utc IS NULL OR typeof(archived_at_utc) = 'integer'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(command_id) = 36), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entry_kinds(kind), "source" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources(source), "actor_member_id" TEXT REFERENCES members(id), "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(occurred_at_utc) = 'integer'), "recorded_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(recorded_at_utc) = 'integer'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "postings" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(line_no) = 'integer' AND line_no >= 0), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor <> 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code), PRIMARY KEY(entry_id, line_no));
CREATE INDEX postings_by_account ON postings (account_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "balance_assertions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer'), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code), "source" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources(source), "entry_id" TEXT REFERENCES journal_entries(id), "asserted_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(asserted_at_utc) = 'integer'));
CREATE INDEX balance_assertions_by_account ON balance_assertions (account_id, asserted_at_utc)
CREATE TRIGGER journal_entries_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON journal_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'journal is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER journal_entries_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON journal_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'journal is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER postings_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'journal is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER postings_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON postings BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'journal is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER balance_assertions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON balance_assertions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'assertions are append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER balance_assertions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON balance_assertions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'assertions are append-only');END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flow_kinds" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('outflow', 'inflow')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_flows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flow_kinds(kind), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies(code), "account_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), "cadence" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cadence IN ('monthly', 'weekly', 'yearly', 'once')), "day" INTEGER CHECK (day IS NULL OR typeof(day) = 'integer'), "month" INTEGER CHECK (month IS NULL OR(typeof(month) = 'integer' AND month BETWEEN 1 AND 12)), "once_on" TEXT CHECK (once_on IS NULL OR(length(once_on) = 10 AND date(once_on) = once_on)), "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(starts_on) = 10 AND date(starts_on) = starts_on), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer'), "archived_at_utc" INTEGER CHECK (archived_at_utc IS NULL OR typeof(archived_at_utc) = 'integer'), CHECK((cadence = 'monthly' AND day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND month IS NULL AND once_on IS NULL)OR(cadence = 'weekly' AND day BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND month IS NULL AND once_on IS NULL)OR(cadence = 'yearly' AND day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND month IS NOT NULL AND once_on IS NULL)OR(cadence = 'once' AND day IS NULL AND month IS NULL AND once_on IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flow_marks" ("flow_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES planned_flows(id), "due_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(due_on) = 10 AND date(due_on) = due_on), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('done', 'skipped')), "marked_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(marked_at_utc) = 'integer'), PRIMARY KEY(flow_id, due_on));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_figures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "grace_amount_minor" INTEGER CHECK (grace_amount_minor IS NULL OR(typeof(grace_amount_minor) = 'integer' AND grace_amount_minor >= 0)), "grace_due_on" TEXT CHECK (grace_due_on IS NULL OR(length(grace_due_on) = 10 AND date(grace_due_on) = grace_due_on)), "min_payment_minor" INTEGER CHECK (min_payment_minor IS NULL OR(typeof(min_payment_minor) = 'integer' AND min_payment_minor >= 0)), "min_due_on" TEXT CHECK (min_due_on IS NULL OR(length(min_due_on) = 10 AND date(min_due_on) = min_due_on)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources(source), "recorded_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(recorded_at_utc) = 'integer'), "settled_at_utc" INTEGER CHECK (settled_at_utc IS NULL OR typeof(settled_at_utc) = 'integer'), CHECK(grace_amount_minor IS NOT NULL OR min_payment_minor IS NOT NULL), CHECK((grace_amount_minor IS NULL)=(grace_due_on IS NULL)), CHECK((min_payment_minor IS NULL)=(min_due_on IS NULL)));
CREATE INDEX card_figures_by_account ON card_figures (account_id, recorded_at_utc)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(sort_order) = 'integer'), "archived_at_utc" INTEGER CHECK (archived_at_utc IS NULL OR typeof(archived_at_utc) = 'integer'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households(id), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('expense', 'income')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "icon" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(icon) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "group_id" TEXT REFERENCES category_groups(id), "ledger_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES accounts(id), "system_key" TEXT CHECK (system_key IS NULL OR length(system_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(sort_order) = 'integer'), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(created_at_utc) = 'integer'), "archived_at_utc" INTEGER CHECK (archived_at_utc IS NULL OR typeof(archived_at_utc) = 'integer'), UNIQUE(household_id, system_key));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entry_details" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES journal_entries(id), "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(occurred_on) = 10 AND date(occurred_on) = occurred_on), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR length(description) <= 200), "counterparty" TEXT CHECK (counterparty IS NULL OR length(counterparty) <= 100), "note" TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 500), "reverses_entry_id" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id), "supersedes_entry_id" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id), "caused_by_entry_id" TEXT REFERENCES journal_entries(id), CHECK(reverses_entry_id IS NULL OR reverses_entry_id <> entry_id), CHECK(supersedes_entry_id IS NULL OR supersedes_entry_id <> entry_id));
CREATE INDEX entry_details_by_cause ON entry_details (caused_by_entry_id)
CREATE TRIGGER entry_details_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON entry_details BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'journal is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER entry_details_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON entry_details BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'journal is append-only');END
